title: additivePipe
body:
## additivePipe

Add material by sweeping one or more closed Body-owned profiles along a connected path. Start a Body without base or join its current tip. Native profiles, sections, orientation guide and corner intent remain editable; follow with attached flanges, bores or other ordinary Body features.

Native binding: `PartDesign::AdditivePipe`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `profile` | one node | yes | `profile` |
| `spine` | one node | yes | `profile` |
| `base` | one node | no | `solid` |
| `sections` | nonempty list | no | `profile` |
| `auxiliary` | one node | no | `profile` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | Section transport: normal(default) uses native Standard; fixed preserves section orientation; frenet follows the Frenet frame; auxiliary uses a required second guide; binormal uses a required nonzero world vector. Choice affects physical cross-section orientation, not merely display. | `{"type":"enum","values":["normal","fixed","frenet","auxiliary","binormal"]}` | `"normal"` |
| `transition` | Corner treatment: transformed(default) requires a tangent-continuous path; miter makes a sharp intersection; rounded asks the native kernel to join around the corner. Some sharp rounded corners fail strict STEP round-trip geometry checks in1.1.4; they are rejected without widening tolerances. | `{"type":"enum","values":["transformed","miter","rounded"]}` | `"transformed"` |
| `binormal` | Required world XYZ direction only for binormal orientation. It must be nonzero; magnitude is not a length. The compiler converts world direction into the native feature frame and readback restores world coordinates, including rotated profiles. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | omitted |
| `auxiliaryEquivalence` | Auxiliary guide correspondence, defaulttrue: match fractional arc length along both paths. False uses native corresponding guide-plane intersections. Set false only for auxiliary orientation; a poorly placed guide can fail geometrically. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` |
